'''Elshuu's mind prison''' was a [[Rakata/Legends|Rakatan]] [[Mind prison]] in which [[Elshuu]] was imprisoned on [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]]. It was stored in the [[Caves of Elshuu]] in [[the Tomb]].<ref name="TOR">{{TORcite|type=faction|[[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]]|Sleeping Rakata|[[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]]}}</ref>
